name: Camping 101: Leatherworking

angles.text: Adele Fielder says a wilderness campsite needs a campfire and urges you to learn cooking so you can kindle one.
In Goldshire, this training guides Alliance leatherworkers toward practical survival crafts for journeys across Azeroth.

faq.answer: Adele Fielder teaches leatherworkers in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest, to make sturdy tents after they show skill in their craft.
faq.q: Who teaches leatherworkers how to craft tents?

faq.answer: A crafted tent shelters travelers from harsh weather, keeping them cool on sweltering days and dry in heavy rain. It also gives adventurers rest in the wilderness.
faq.q: What purpose does a crafted tent serve?

aliases: can i pitch tent in town
faq.answer: You cannot pitch a tent in town streets or town centers. Take your gear into the wilderness to set up camp.
faq.q: Can you pitch a tent inside a town?

aliases: what else do i need for camp
faq.answer: Adele Fielder says a camp needs a campfire as well as a tent, for warmth and practical use in the wild.
faq.q: What else is needed alongside a tent to complete a camp?

faq.answer: Culinary trainers and local cooks teach the basics of lighting a campfire. Learn from them so you can build a reliable fire wherever you roam.
faq.q: Where can a traveler learn to build a campfire?

faq.answer: A leatherworker must first show skill in the craft before Adele Fielder teaches tentmaking.
faq.q: When can a leatherworker learn to craft a camping tent?

sections.body: Beyond the gates of Goldshire, shelter matters as much as armor. In Elwynn Forest, leatherworkers can visit Adele Fielder to learn more than simple belts and tunics. After they show skill with hide and needle, Adele teaches them to make a durable tent for long journeys overland. It is built to withstand harsh weather.
sections.title: Shelter for the Open Road

sections.body:
A finished tent covers a campsite and guards against the elements. It keeps travelers cool under scorching suns, dry in driving rain, and rested between dangerous encounters.

Goldshire locals and city guards will not allow campsites in the town streets, so you need to head into the open wilderness to camp. Adele also reminds wanderers that a proper camp needs a campfire. A culinary trainer can teach you to make one.
sections.title: The Essentials of Campcraft

summary: In Goldshire, Adele Fielder teaches leatherworkers to make a tent for journeys beyond town. It shelters travelers from harsh weather and gives them a place to rest while camping in the wilderness.
